## Variables

### webOriginSchema

```ts
const webOriginSchema: ZodPipe<ZodString, ZodTransform<string, string>>;
```

Parse one allowed embed origin: exact `https://host[:port]`, one leading `*.`
subdomain level, or `http` only on loopback for development. Paths, credentials,
queries and bare wildcards are rejected. The Hub stores and enforces these;
Settings runs the same schema before it sends one.

### transcriptLine()

```ts
function transcriptLine(message): TranscriptLine | null;
```

The visible line of one message: a visitor's prompt or the Agent's reply. Tool
traffic and empty turns are not conversation, so they have no line.
